name: fda cosmetics listing preparation

product.purpose: Prepare reader-checked, rules-checked cosmetic product listing packets from Shopify catalog records and brand-confirmed label, ingredient, facility, and exemption data.
product.channel: Shopify App Store draft; local Glacier automation until the owner completes app review.
product.billing: Monthly subscription by product count; checkout is not enabled until the owner configures the customer layer.
product.government_submission: The brand confirms, signs where required, uploads the SPL ZIP to FDA Cosmetics Direct, and submits. Glacier does not submit or sign.

schedules.purpose: Check local FDA listing deadline reminders each morning.

your_steps.title: Connect a Shopify store and provide label details
your_steps.detail: Create the Shopify app and grant the read_products scope. Paste the four Shopify values into the labeled fields on this step; Glacier saves them in this computer's keychain. Provide the label name, FDA product category code, ingredients, facility FEI or confirmed exemption checklist, and first-marketed and last-listed dates for each product. Records stay marked uncertain until you confirm them.

your_steps.title: Review and submit the FDA listing
your_steps.when: After a packet passes local checks
your_steps.detail: Review every field and source, confirm the exemption checklist and ingredients, then sign where required and upload the ZIP to FDA Cosmetics Direct. You submit it to FDA; Glacier never signs or submits.

your_steps.title: Review and submit the Shopify app
your_steps.detail: Complete Shopify's current app review and listing steps, including the required privacy and support details. Glacier does not create accounts or publish the app.

launch_gates: Owner completes Shopify Partner/App Store review.
Brand confirms the exemption checklist and every extracted ingredient.
Customer reviews, signs where required, and submits every FDA filing.
